name: Hokonohara Kotarou
source:
He is the son of a rich and wealthy family with connections to the Daiunji Zaibatsu.  Naturally, he's never had issues with money and has been playing around with women since a young age.

He views women as nothing more than tools for his sexual gratification, he comes up with schemes to get any girl he likes. His personality is perhaps directly related to his abilities. He believes himself to be untouchable.

He is acquainted with the principal of the school, and in his heart, he is determined to win her for himself, but in terms of power, the principal is the most powerful, so he is unable to take her.

He has the appearance of a host, and is a rich brat who is always gnawing on his parents' shins. He throws tantrums when he is not free to do what he wants.

P/A: Reflector

Hobbies: Sports, driving
Special Skills: Karate, sleight of hand, badger games, tricking people
Likes: Humiliated faces, crying women
Dislikes: Confident people, people who talk back, informal language

[From [url=https://www.empress-game.com/PA/top.html]official site[/url]]
